cards.name: Academy Researchers
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may put an Aura card from your hand onto the battlefield attached to this creature.

cards.name: Blood Researcher
cards.oracleText:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Cartographer's Survey
cards.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put up to two land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Compulsive Research
cards.oracleText: Target player draws three cards. Then that player discards two cards unless they discard a land card.

cards.name: Combat Research
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
As long as enchanted creature is legendary, it gets +1/+1 and has ward {1}. (Whenever enchanted creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {1}.)

cards.name: Desperate Research
cards.oracleText: Choose a card name other than a basic land card name. Reveal the top seven cards of your library and put all of them with that name into your hand. Exile the rest.

cards.name: Firemind's Research
cards.oracleText:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a charge counter on this enchantment.
{1}{U}, Remove two charge counters from this enchantment: Draw a card.
{1}{R}, Remove five charge counters from this enchantment: It deals 5 damage to any target.

cards.name: Field Research
cards.oracleText:
Kicker {2}{U} (You may pay an additional {2}{U} as you cast this spell.)
Draw two cards. If this spell was kicked, draw three cards instead.

cards.name: Forensic Researcher
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Untap another target permanent you control.
{T}, Collect evidence 3: Tap target creature you don't control. (To collect evidence 3, exile cards with total mana value 3 or greater from your graveyard.)

cards.name: Hapless Researcher
cards.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Research the Deep
cards.oracleText: Draw a card. Clash with an opponent. If you win, return Research the Deep to its owner's hand. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)

cards.name: Practical Research
cards.oracleText: Draw four cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an instant or sorcery card.

cards.name: Wild Research
cards.oracleText:
{1}{W}: Search your library for an enchantment card and reveal that card. Put it into your hand, then discard a card at random. Then shuffle.
{1}{U}: Search your library for an instant card and reveal that card. Put it into your hand, then discard a card at random. Then shuffle.

cards.name: Perilous Research
cards.oracleText: Draw two cards, then sacrifice a permanent.

cards.name: Warped Researcher
cards.oracleText: Whenever a player cycles a card, this creature gains flying and shroud until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities.)

cards.name: Rowdy Research
cards.oracleText:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature that attacked this turn.
Draw three cards.

cards.name: Private Research
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a page counter on this Aura.
When enchanted creature dies, draw a card for each page counter on this Aura.
